notes.summary: Handwritten page 69 introduces the subdivision order, discusses common subdivisions and the word for comparability, defines a moderated contrée, and states C5 on disjointness. Two slanted notes concern strengthening the condition and moving disjunction axioms. The page contains worked corrections, a four-object diagram, and no date or title.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem was proved or independently re-proved. Mathematical structure only prompted checking the prime counts, bowed versus straight order signs, the shared right-hand F in the diagram, and the corrected G in the NB. Those decisions follow visible strokes; the unusual F triple prime in the prose and the unmatched (i.e. are preserved. The transcribed claim about Sup/inf was not validated.
notes.author_checks: The cancelled on a and cancelled underlined C5 explain the two H unreadable deletions around Je...donner; no additional deleted word was invented. The single worked d-un(e) group is not expanded into two complete words. Both slanted notes were framed in full before rotation. The upper-right relation has an extra arm whose deletion state remains open. H editorial remarks were treated as editorial remarks, not manuscript wording.
